evals.prompt: this site looks AI-made, dots everywhere, gradient in the heading. fix evals/fixtures/broken-site/index.html, don't touch the copy
evals.expected_output: The same copy and contact, without the decorative dot, pill, gradient text, blur or Inter, with the em dash reported as a decision (the copy is off limits), and with three rejected defaults and a signature written down.
assertions: The file has no .dot element and no dot before 'Taking orders' (or it's replaced with text alone)
There's no background-clip: text and no backdrop-filter
font-family doesn't start with Inter
The em dash in the H1 is reported as a decision for the user, because the prompt forbids changes to the copy
The tel: link and the phone number are unchanged
The reply lists three rejected defaults and one signature element
The grep from point 4 of the skill on the fixed file returns no hits that lack a justification in the reply

evals.prompt: add an indicator to the dashboard showing whether the server is online, the data comes from /api/health every 10 seconds
evals.expected_output: The status indicator stays because it carries a real state: static, with a text label, with its appearance changing only when the state changes.
assertions: The indicator has a text label (e.g. 'Online' / 'Offline'), not just a coloured dot
No pulsing animation at rest

evals.prompt: make a section with three benefits of the service on an accounting firm's landing page
evals.expected_output: A section without three identical cards with an icon in a coloured square, without an eyebrow and without a gradient.
assertions: It isn't three cards with the identical layout icon in a square + title + sentence
There's no uppercase label above the section heading
There's no purple or indigo gradient

evals.prompt: choose fonts and icons for the landing page of a bicycle repair shop in Kraków, the site is in Polish. not Inter and not Lucide again
evals.expected_output: A typeface chosen by the method in references/typefaces.md (voice, genre, a shortlist from at least two sources), not from the reflex list, with its reason, source and licence and the Polish letters checked; icons only where they help, from a set matched to the typeface.
assertions: None of the chosen typefaces is on the reflex list in references/typefaces.md
The reply shows a shortlist of at least four candidates from at least two sources before the choice
For each chosen typeface the reply gives a reason tied to the subject, the source and the licence
The reply confirms the Polish letters (ą ć ę ł ń ó ś ź ż) in the weights used, e.g. with a rendered test line
The reply says where the page has no icons and why; the set for the rest isn't Lucide, Heroicons or Feather, and the choice is justified by its stroke or terminals matching the typeface
The fonts are self-hosted or loaded at build time, with no runtime request to fonts.googleapis.com

evals.prompt: make the hero and the pricing section for our SaaS landing page in Next.js with shadcn/ui. I don't want it to look like every other shadcn site, but the dialogs and the dropdown menu have to keep working
evals.expected_output: shadcn primitives kept, the theme rewritten from a written decision, no stock card structure everywhere, no animated-kit effects without a reason, keyboard behaviour intact.
assertions: globals.css doesn't keep shadcn's default grey neutrals and its single default --radius; the colours come from named values written down in the reply
The hero isn't a Card, and not every block is a Card with CardTitle and a grey CardDescription
There's no BorderBeam, ShimmerButton, Spotlight, Meteors, Marquee, NumberTicker or dot or grid background, or the single kept effect is justified by what it shows about the product
Dialog and DropdownMenu still use the Radix (or Base UI) primitives and work with the keyboard (Tab, Esc, arrows)
Utility icons inside components (close, chevron) stay; there are no decorative icons in tinted squares
The reply lists three rejected defaults and one signature element

evals.prompt: the hero headline on our electrician's site is flat, same weight, centred, the H1 barely bigger than the line under it. make the text look designed, but don't change the words: "Electrical installations in Gdańsk, from the first socket to the inspection certificate"
evals.expected_output: The same words ranked by importance and set as a lockup with 2–3 levels that differ in size and weight, all in one h1, working at 375 px, without an eyebrow.
assertions: The words of the headline are unchanged

The whole headline is one h1, with spans for the levels rather than separate elements or
chains
The reply ranks the words (what is read first, second, third) before the code
The word or phrase ranked first differs from the rest in both size (a clear jump) and weight
The small part is a piece of the same sentence, not a category label, and there's no uppercase letter-spaced label above the heading
At 375 px there's no horizontal overflow and no line with a single short word
No part of the headline is rendered as an image or as SVG outlines
